description: Served with the Soviet Air Force Turkestan Military District 111th Independent Composite Aviation Regiment at Tuzel in an Aeroflot colour scheme; almost certainly wore bort "02 blue" which faded to appear white; moved dismantled from Tuzel and erected in spring 1986 at Akaltyn as a Ministry of Defence gift to the district for its record of entrants to military schools; repainted into Uzbekistan Airways colours in summer-autumn 2011; a surviving Tu-124 of any kind is rare
